hooks.name: Weekly reading digest reminder
hooks.description: At session start, check whether the weekly Anthropic/OpenAI reading digest (graph task reading-digest) is due and offer to run it.

action.prompt: Weekly reading check: read the latest comment on docs/graph/nodes/reading-digest.json (npm run -s graph -- show reading-digest). If the last recorded reading date is 7 or more days before today, tell the user the weekly Anthropic/OpenAI agent-engineering digest is due and offer to start it (bundled://investigate with the brief pattern of .agents/tasks/reading-2026-10-29, starting from the last date read). Do not start it without the user's go.
